guide.overview: Using the supplied procedures, interpret evidence from a bounded deployment, identify unsafe or incomplete conditions, and recommend justified verification, correction and escalation steps. Fictional feasibility-study example; no credential is offered.
guide.audience: Partner implementers; excludes architecture, incident command and commercial management.
guide.eligibility: Design: first recruit six volunteer partner consultants with varied experience for a feasibility study; no enrollment has occurred.

guide.permitted_resources: Design: supplied versioned procedures and individual work. No outside or generative assistance during the study; accessible equivalents arranged before participation.
guide.accommodations: Contact Morgan privately before scheduling; final process/contact route pending.
guide.retakes: No pass/fail, awards or operational retake entitlement in this feasibility study.
guide.appeals: Raise concerns privately to Morgan; deadline and independent reviewer pending.
